name: layout-hotkeys
title: Layout Hotkeys
description: Jump straight to a specific keyboard layout with a hotkey, instead of cycling through them.
author: pavelkh

commands.name: slot-1
commands.title: Switch to Layout 1
commands.description: Switch to the input source assigned to slot 1. Bind a global hotkey to this command.

commands.name: slot-2
commands.title: Switch to Layout 2
commands.description: Switch to the input source assigned to slot 2. Bind a global hotkey to this command.

commands.name: slot-3
commands.title: Switch to Layout 3
commands.description: Switch to the input source assigned to slot 3. Bind a global hotkey to this command.

commands.name: slot-4
commands.title: Switch to Layout 4
commands.description: Switch to the input source assigned to slot 4. Bind a global hotkey to this command.

commands.name: convert-1
commands.title: Convert Selection to Layout 1
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text as if it had been typed with the layout assigned to slot 1.

commands.name: convert-2
commands.title: Convert Selection to Layout 2
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text as if it had been typed with the layout assigned to slot 2.

commands.name: convert-3
commands.title: Convert Selection to Layout 3
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text as if it had been typed with the layout assigned to slot 3.

commands.name: convert-4
commands.title: Convert Selection to Layout 4
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text as if it had been typed with the layout assigned to slot 4.

commands.name: convert
commands.title: Convert Selection
commands.description: Preview the selected text rewritten into each of your layouts and pick one.

commands.name: configure
commands.title: Configure Layout Slots
commands.description: Choose which input source each Switch to Layout hotkey selects.

commands.name: cycle
commands.title: Cycle Input Source
commands.description: Switch to the next enabled input source.

commands.name: current
commands.title: Show Current Input Source
commands.description: Show which input source is currently active.

commands.name: index
commands.title: Switch Input Source
commands.description: Browse enabled input sources and switch to one.

preferences.name: showHud
preferences.title: Feedback
preferences.label: Show a HUD after switching
preferences.description: Off by default — the HUD keeps Raycast on screen after the switch and makes it feel slow.

preferences.name: whenNothingSelected
preferences.title: When Nothing Is Selected
preferences.description: What the Convert Selection commands do when you have not selected any text.

preferences.name: switchAfterConvert
preferences.title: After Converting
preferences.label: Switch to the target layout
preferences.description: After rewriting text into another layout, make that layout active so you can keep typing in it.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the `prepublishOnly` script and rerun `npm publish` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use `npm run publish` instead.

" && exit 1
